entries.good_example: fetch_data() { local retry=0; until curl --fail -s "$1"; do ((retry++)); [[ $retry -gt 3 ]] && exit 1; sleep $((2**retry)); done; }
entries.rationale: Network calls are flaky. SS QLM mandates retry logic with increasing wait times to prevent overwhelming the target service while ensuring delivery.

entries.good_example: VERSION=$(curl -s ... | jq -r '.version') || { echo "Failed to parse JSON"; exit 1; }
entries.rationale: Parsing JSON with grep/sed is brittle and breaks with structural changes. SS QLM standardizes 'jq' for reliable, schema-aware data extraction.
